paragraphs: He is mentioned in Eruvin 8a: he reported the teaching “and the Sages prohibit”; R' Nachman said, “The halakhah follows the Sages.” Hyman infers that he lived in R' Nachman’s time.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ר״נ is contextually Nachman in this ruling report, with title R'; no exact named full-title evidence is bound. Full heading Rav stays. The terse punctuation leaves Yosef’s exact contribution boundary unclear, while the source order and prohibition/ruling are retained. Dating is explicitly Hyman’s inference rather than established chronology.
ח. gives 8a by convention without new verification. Inherited provisional heading/uncertain scan status remains unadjudicated.
